title: Try a capture with Pip
intro: Pip has set up an example, not a match. You play Black. Place stones on crossings with a click or Space.
Empty crossings beside a stone are its liberties. Diagonals do not count. Fill the last liberty to capture.

steps.instruction: The ring shows White's last liberty. Play there to capture the stone.
steps.hint: The empty crossing directly below White is its last liberty.
steps.explanation: White had one liberty. Your stone filled it, so White came off the board. That is a capture.

outro: You made a capture in Pip's example. You can try Capture Go from an empty board, repeat this example, or ask Pip where to learn the full game.
